title: Adds a small script which parses britney logs for a specified release.
description:
Adds a small script which parses britney logs for a specified release.

You can search via a package, a string, or a regex

+#!/usr/bin/python3
+
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import pathlib
+import re
+import sys
+import gzip
+
+import requests
+
+base_url = "https://ubuntu-archive-team.ubuntu.com/proposed-migration/log/"
+
+
+def parse_args():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="parsing britney logs - one of --package, --string, or --regex is required"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--last-x-days",
+        type=int,
+        required=True,
+        default=1,
+        help="Last X days to parse logs from -  default is 1 (today)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--output-file",
+        "-o",
+        type=str,
+        required=False,
+        help="output filepath - send output of script to file instead of printing",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--package",
+        type=str,
+        required=False,
+        help="Search for loglines with mention of a package",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--string",
+        type=str,
+        required=False,
+        help="Search for a specific string",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--release",
+        type=str,
+        required=True,
+        help="Check britney logs for a specific release",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--regex",
+        type=str,
+        required=False,
+        help="Search with a regex",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if not args.string and not args.regex and not args.package:
+        print("You must specify at least one of --string, --package or --regex")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    return args
+
+
+def get_list_of_dates(last_x_days):
+    now = datetime.datetime.now()
+    list_of_dates = []
+    for _ in range(last_x_days):
+        list_of_dates.append(now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
+        now = now - datetime.timedelta(days=1)
+    return list_of_dates
+
+
+def gather_logs_for_day(day, release):
+    page = requests.get(f"{base_url}/{release}/{day}/").content.decode("utf-8")
+    logs = []
+    logfiles = []
+    for line in page.splitlines():
+        if re.search(r"\d\d:\d\d:\d\d.log", line) is not None:
+            logs.append(re.search(r"\d\d:\d\d:\d\d.log", line).group(0))
+        # no elif just in case we have compressed and not compressed logs
+        # on the same day
+        if re.search(r"\d\d:\d\d:\d\d.log.gz", line) is not None:
+            logs.append(re.search(r"\d\d:\d\d:\d\d.log.gz", line).group(0))
+    for log in logs:
+        try:
+            if log.endswith(".log"):
+                logfile = requests.get(
+                    f"{base_url}/{release}/{day}/{log}"
+                ).content.decode()
+            elif log.endswith(".log.gz"):
+                compressed_logfile = requests.get(
+                    f"{base_url}/{release}/{day}/{log}"
+                ).content
+                logfile = gzip.decompress(compressed_logfile).decode("utf-8")
+            logfiles.append(logfile)
+        except UnicodeDecodeError as _:
+            pass
+    return logfiles
+
+
+def parse_logs(args, dates):
+    hits = []
+    if args.regex:
+        filter_re = re.compile(args.regex, re.DOTALL)
+    for date in dates:
+        logfiles = gather_logs_for_day(date, args.release)
+        for log in logfiles:
+            for line in log.splitlines():
+                if "Read pending requested tests" in line:
+                    continue
+                if args.package and args.string and args.regex:
+                    if (
+                        args.package in line
+                        and args.string in line
+                        and filter_re.search(line)
+                    ):
+                        hits.append(line)
+                elif args.package and args.string:
+                    if args.package in line and args.string in line:
+                        hits.append(line)
+                elif args.package and args.regex:
+                    if args.package in line and filter_re.search(line):
+                        hits.append(line)
+                elif args.string and args.regex:
+                    if args.string in line and filter_re.search(line):
+                        hits.append(line)
+                elif args.package and args.package in line:
+                    hits.append(line)
+                elif args.string and args.string in line:
+                    hits.append(line)
+                elif args.regex and filter_re.search(line):
+                    hits.append(line)
+    return hits
+
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args()
+    list_of_dates = get_list_of_dates(args.last_x_days)
+    logs = parse_logs(args, list_of_dates)
+    if args.output_file:
+        pathlib.Path(args.output_file).write_text(("\n").join(logs))
+    else:
+        print("\n".join(logs))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
